names: International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction

events.text: Hundreds of Knights Templar are arrested across France.
The cornerstone of the White House is laid in Washington, D.C.
Battle of Queenston Heights in the War of 1812.
Italy declares war on its former ally Germany.
Uruguayan Air Force Flight 571 crashes in the Andes.
The last of 33 trapped miners is rescued in Chile after 69 days underground.

births.text: Margaret Thatcher, Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
